svg.title: Enthalpies for the open-steam column (ethanol–water, 1 kg/cm²)
svg.text: Enthalpies for the open-steam column (ethanol–water, 1 kg/cm²)
Ethanol–water enthalpy–composition chart at 1 kg/cm² (after Bosnjakovic; Wankat Fig. 2-4), redrawn
Auxiliary line for interpolating equilibrium compositions
Find the composition on the x axis (H₁, h_D at 0.60; h_F at 0.30; h_B at 0.05; steam at 0).
Go straight up to the curve: dew line (sat. vapor), boiling line (sat. liquid) or a liquid isotherm (subcooled).
Go across to the enthalpy axis (the nearer side).
Read H₁ ≈ 405, h_D ≈ 65, h_F ≈ 9 (20 °C isotherm), h_B ≈ 91, H_S ≈ 639 kcal/kg.
Redrawn from the chart data (curves fitted to the readings used in the solutions); in the exam read the printed chart — values may differ slightly.
